Application Testing

We test for who matters and what matters to them.

The quality of the success of day-to-day operations of complex and critical businesses with the consistent challenges posed by the dynamically evolving environment , keeping pace with progressively competitive industry, in addition to the demand of the need to provide customer focused solutions, which are accomplished by innovative dimensions of customer experience, firms must ensure the solutions would meet the exponentially rising customer expectations. Domtree’ Testing solutions and services understand the challenges and business needs to bring effective combination of proven methodologies and best practices deployed in the process , and technology that ensures to achieve the objectives of quality in delivery of meeting requirements on time and with a measurable ROI and a reduction in Cost of Quality (CoQ). We strive to improve software testing practices and have built a team of international test experts and consultants that deliver customized testing solutions, consulting, and outsourcing services to companies that are looking to improve their software testing and QA processes. Domtree is specialized in setting up end-to-end software test process and methodology to ensure highest level of test solution delivered to achieve customer satisfaction. Domtree offers a complete and comprehensive suite of software testing services spanning consulting, enterprise services and functionality testing. Built upon in-depth vertical knowledge acquired by a team of test experts with advanced skills and expertise over various technologies across a wide range of industries, we flexibly map our service delivery to evolving business needs.

Core Testing ServicesThe basic things done right.

![The basic things done right.](./assets/images/graph-outline.png)

A rich, secure and multi-channel customer experience is not just a value addition, but critical for the success of Digital Transformation, making QA & Testing more important than ever. We recognise that Digital Transformation puts rich multi-channel customer experience< and operational efficiency at the heart of QA objectives for Enterprises. Our testing services focus on delivering Digital Assurance through context driven approach, with cost-of-quality and ROI in mind.

Specialized Testing ServicesWhere you need experts' advice.

![Where you need experts' advice.](./assets/images/graph-outline.png)

Proper tooling and automation of the right tasks in test management will greatly improve its value and benefits. Domtree also provides services of implementing commercial and open-source tools for Test Management, Requirement Management,Bug Tracking , Code Coverage, and also has the expertise build Customized Framework solutions.

Read more

Solutions and AcceleratorsThe best lessons learnt put to use.

![The best lessons learnt put to use.](./assets/images/graph-outline.png)

Individual applications are no longer just components of a larger enterprise system as it gets more complex in magnitude and intricacies. Domtree’ business-backward approach provides more test coverage on the aspects of functionality when testing a wide range of applications, with a complex architecture. The integrated system has to be validated against the business needs and also for its user-friendliness- including user navigation, data consumption & contribution, business workflows, UI screens, and integrations. Functional testing must cover the obvious surface-level functions, as well as back-end operations such as security, usability, accessibility, web-services and upgrades. Domtree’ Specialized Testing services can help with testing various functionalities and compatibility of a product before implementation on a platform or system through various offerings in addition to Functional Testing Services, SOA Testing,Testing solution for heterogeneous applications, which are loosely coupled and having complex orchestration.

Read more

Test AutomationTest Automation is the use of software to test software.

![Test Automation is the use of software to test software.](./assets/images/graph-outline.png)

Functional Test automation, as an accelerator, is more than a strategic solution in the current economic environment of plummeting cycle times and mounting budget pressures, offers numerous advantages and frustrating because organizations are not able to achieve the full potential and have to continuously show ROI.

Read more

Performance EngineeringGet your apps validated for performance and reliability.

![Get your apps validated for performance and reliability.](./assets/images/graph-outline.png)

The prime reasons leading to embarrassing and costly crashes when your web applications are deployed, are when your performance tests overestimated the performance and scalability of the web applications. In other cases, they underestimated capacity and scalability – leading to unnecessary spending on hardware and infrastructure. At the highest level, performance testing is almost always conducted to address one or more risks related to expense, opportunity costs, continuity, and or or corporate reputation.

Read more

Mobile Application TestingGet your mobile apps validated for market readiness and reliability.

![Get your mobile apps validated for market readiness and reliability.](./assets/images/graph-outline.png)

A plethora of options over mobility through hand held devices and various platforms that are used to build the volume of Business, Smart phones and Personal digital assistants brings forth the challenges of providing the user experience that is as good as their desktop based counter-parts, for the users to congregate their personal and professional necessities. Data Security, Usability, Performance, Compatibility, are many other factors that could impact the user and the enterprise as well. The mobile applications that use cloud to communicate with the ERP systems demands intensified testing efforts in functionality and integration testing.

Read more

Test Process ConsultingGet your apps tested and ready for market.

![Get your apps tested and ready for market.](./assets/images/graph-outline.png)

In an organization, that requires to manage and execute multiple programmes and complex projects , Testing is not just an activity about reducing risk , but ensuring control that would bring in several significant benefits, by establishing a sustainable improvement plan in alignment with the over-all organization Quality objectives and by measuring the effectiveness of each phase of testing within an individual project. Domtree helps you address your key test process challenges, realize a higher level of test maturity and achieve more streamlined and efficient processes improving your testing process provides several significant benefits.

Read more

Test Management and StrategyGet your apps tested and ready for market.

![Get your apps tested and ready for market.](./assets/images/graph-outline.png)

Most of the prime reasons to consider improving a test process using advancing test management practices beyond old-fashioned, document-based methods are the most practical challenges. Test management would face Not enough time to test Not enough resources to complete test within the target dates Leverage the advantages of having teams that are geographically separated including communication and efficient response times to changing requirements across time-zones. Having a test team, not having sufficient product knowledge Manage to fall sync with development schedules in an agile environment Control costs and conserve efforts and maintain quality in the deliverables Automate the process to conserve efforts on redundant activities Measure and introduce Business Intelligence, communicating through effective reports, that would speed up the process of decision making on critical issues. Predict the impossible and mitigate the risks with effective test planning and a strong test strategy Monitor and measure the test coverage over executions of iterative cycles and track the progress achieved. Document and Maintain the test artifacts and deliverables of high quality to the business user.
